semiconductor_relevance: High — Jing Cheng Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the R&D and manufacturing of Silicon Carbide (SiC) wafers, which are critical for semiconductor applications.
summary: Jing Cheng Material Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and development of Silicon Carbide (SiC) materials, leveraging a team with extensive experience in compound crystal production. The company aims to enhance yield stability and operational efficiency in the semiconductor supply chain, particularly for electric vehicle and 5G markets.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is positioned to become a leading supplier of SiC materials in Taiwan, focusing on high-specification production systems.
